understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be moved with directional actions through open grid spaces, while walls and obstacles blocked movement. CLICK switched the selected piece or moved it to a clicked reachable position, but clicks on blocked or invalid locations had no effect. Multiple pieces and goals all had to be handled without exhausting the finite action budget.
